WITH config AS (
  SELECT jsonb_object_agg(key,value) AS values
  FROM settings
  WHERE key LIKE 'VALIDATION_%'
), started AS (
  INSERT INTO pipeline_runs (workflow,status,metadata)
  SELECT '11 - TrendLens - Phase 12 Validation','running',
         jsonb_build_object(
           'configuration',coalesce(values,'{}'::jsonb),
           'window_policy','closed_hour',
           'quantitative_source','postgresql',
           'manual_classifier_review',true,
           'automatic_weight_adjustment',false
         )
  FROM config
  RETURNING id,started_at,metadata
)
SELECT id AS pipeline_run_id,started_at AS run_started_at,metadata
FROM started;

WITH generated AS (
  SELECT * FROM build_phase12_validation($2::timestamptz)
), inserted AS (
  INSERT INTO pipeline_validation_reports (
    period_start,period_end,generated_at,validation_version,
    overall_status,sample_size,reviewed_classifications,report_json,source_hash
  )
  SELECT
    period_start,period_end,generated_at,validation_version,
    overall_status,sample_size,reviewed_classifications,report_json,source_hash
  FROM generated
  ON CONFLICT (period_start,period_end,validation_version,source_hash)
  DO NOTHING
  RETURNING pipeline_validation_reports.*,true AS report_created
), resolved AS (
  SELECT * FROM inserted
  UNION ALL
  SELECT existing.*,false AS report_created
  FROM pipeline_validation_reports existing
  CROSS JOIN generated
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inserted)
    AND existing.period_start=generated.period_start
    AND existing.period_end=generated.period_end
    AND existing.validation_version=generated.validation_version
    AND existing.source_hash=generated.source_hash
  LIMIT 1
), updated AS (
  UPDATE pipeline_runs
  SET items_received=resolved.sample_size,
      metadata=metadata || jsonb_build_object(
        'validation_report_id',resolved.id,
        'report_created',resolved.report_created,
        'overall_status',resolved.overall_status,
        'sample_size',resolved.sample_size,
        'reviewed_classifications',resolved.reviewed_classifications,
        'period_start',resolved.period_start,
        'period_end',resolved.period_end,
        'validation_version',resolved.validation_version,
        'source_hash',resolved.source_hash
      )
  FROM resolved
  WHERE pipeline_runs.id=$1::bigint
  RETURNING pipeline_runs.id
)
SELECT
  updated.id AS pipeline_run_id,
  resolved.id AS validation_report_id,
  resolved.report_created,
  resolved.overall_status,
  resolved.period_start,
  resolved.period_end,
  resolved.generated_at,
  resolved.validation_version,
  resolved.sample_size,
  resolved.reviewed_classifications,
  resolved.source_hash
FROM updated CROSS JOIN resolved;

WITH args AS (
  SELECT $1::bigint AS run_id
), candidates AS (
  SELECT to_jsonb(candidate) AS item
  FROM select_classification_review_candidates(30,'phase12-v1') candidate
), candidate_payload AS (
  SELECT count(*)::integer AS candidate_count,
         coalesce(jsonb_agg(item),'[]'::jsonb) AS items
  FROM candidates
), updated AS (
  UPDATE pipeline_runs
  SET finished_at=coalesce(finished_at,current_timestamp),
      status='success',
      items_processed=CASE WHEN (metadata ->> 'report_created')::boolean THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
      items_skipped=CASE WHEN (metadata ->> 'report_created')::boolean THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
      duration_seconds=coalesce(duration_seconds,extract(epoch FROM (current_timestamp-started_at))),
      metadata=metadata || jsonb_build_object(
        'manual_review_candidates',candidate_payload.candidate_count
      )
  FROM args
  CROSS JOIN candidate_payload
  WHERE pipeline_runs.id=args.run_id
  RETURNING pipeline_runs.*
)
SELECT
  updated.id AS pipeline_run_id,
  updated.workflow,
  updated.status,
  updated.items_received,
  updated.items_processed,
  updated.items_skipped,
  updated.items_failed,
  updated.duration_seconds,
  updated.metadata,
  updated.started_at,
  updated.finished_at,
  report.id AS validation_report_id,
  report.overall_status,
  report.period_start,
  report.period_end,
  report.validation_version,
  report.sample_size,
  report.reviewed_classifications,
  report.report_json,
  report.source_hash,
  candidate_payload.candidate_count AS review_candidate_count,
  candidate_payload.items AS review_candidates
FROM updated
CROSS JOIN candidate_payload
LEFT JOIN pipeline_validation_reports report
  ON report.id=(updated.metadata ->> 'validation_report_id')::bigint;

WITH args AS (
  SELECT $1::bigint AS run_id,$2::text AS node_name,$3::text AS message
), logged AS (
  INSERT INTO pipeline_errors (
    pipeline_run_id,workflow,node,error_type,error_message,retry_count,metadata
  )
  SELECT args.run_id,'11 - TrendLens - Phase 12 Validation',
         left(args.node_name,255),'phase12_validation_error',
         left(regexp_replace(args.message,'(?i)(authorization|api[_-]?key|token|password|secret)[^ ,;]*','[REDACTED]','g'),4000),
         2,jsonb_build_object(
           'manual_classifier_review',true,
           'automatic_weight_adjustment',false
         )
  FROM args
  RETURNING id
), updated AS (
  UPDATE pipeline_runs
  SET finished_at=current_timestamp,status='failed',items_failed=items_failed+1,
      duration_seconds=extract(epoch FROM (current_timestamp-started_at))
  FROM args
  WHERE pipeline_runs.id=args.run_id
  RETURNING pipeline_runs.*
)
SELECT updated.id AS pipeline_run_id,updated.status,updated.items_failed,
       (SELECT id FROM logged) AS pipeline_error_id
FROM updated;
